law_name: Law No. 154/AN/06 of July 23, 2006 on the Protection of Copyright and Related Rights
term_of_protection: Author's life + 50 years (Art. 12; cinematographic works 50 years (Art. 15); photographs and applied art 25 years from creation (Art. 16))
enforcement_body: Djibouti Office of Copyright and Related Rights (Office Djiboutien des Droits d'Auteur et de Droit Voisin, ODDA)
notes: Djibouti is NOT an OAPI member (absent from the 17-member list); Berne accession 13 May 2002; WTO member since 1995 per US Copyright Office circular; WCT/WPPT not confirmed; Law 114/AN/96 repealed
